subject: general
question: Asoka, arguably the most famous ruler of early India, conquered Kalinga. He was the grandson of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** (circa 321–297 BCE) was the founder of the Maurya Empire.
 
• Chandragupta is believed to have been born in either **Pataliputra (modern-day Patna, Bihar) or Pipliya, Madhya Pradesh, around 340 BCE**.
 
• Chandragupta, with the assistance of Chanakya, **overthrew the Nanda dynasty** in Magadha.
 
• Toward the end of his life, Chandragupta is believed to have **embraced Jainism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Samduragupta** was given the title of** “Napoleon of India”** by modern historian V.A. Smith due to his numerous conquests.
 
• He was the **son of Chandragupta I** and succeeded him as the ruler of the Gupta Empire.
 
• **Chandragupta II**, also known as **Vikramaditya**, was the son of Samudragupta and one of the greatest emperors of the Gupta dynasty.
 
• His reign is often considered the height of the Gupta Empire and the** Golden Age of India**.
 
• **Prabhavati Gupta** was the daughter of Chandragupta II and was married to Rudrasena II, a ruler of the Vakataka dynasty.
